CustomField.description: Calculates the total cost of the Service Ticket. Formula: Sum(Parts + Labor + Misc + Fixed) + Tax. Tax logic: Parts, Misc, and Fixed are always taxed at the Tax_Rate__c. Labor is only taxed if Is_Labor_Taxable__c is checked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The final amount payable. Includes Parts, Labor, Misc fees, and Tax. Note: Labor is only taxed if the "Tax Labor?" box is checked.
CustomField.label: Grand Total
